{"id":23,"company":"CPI Aerostructures, Inc.","risk_score":90,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Restated 2018 and earlier periods for contract accounting errors; SEC brought an enforcement action."},
{"id":24,"company":"Gentex Corporation","risk_score":5,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"No known accounting problems."},
{"id":25,"company":"National Presto Industries, Inc.","risk_score":22,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Earlier SEC matter concerned Investment Company Act status, not 2022 accounting; material weakness disclosed for 2022."},

{"id":27,"company":"Welbilt, Inc.","risk_score":70,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Restated 2018 and earlier periods after errors in tax and other accounts; material weaknesses; SEC enforcement."},
